analysis:mixed_move_report_tomorrow.description: Falls about twice as far as its peers, the day before reporting.
analysis:mixed_move_report_tomorrow.first_output: AMD fell 4.2%, 3.6 points more than the market and 2.2 points more than the median of its AI compute peers, which declined around 2%. The only coverage item notes that the company reports third-quarter results after tomorrow's close, suggesting the move may reflect positioning ahead of the event rather than any specific news today. The stock has shown substantial reactions to earnings lately, with a median abnormal move of 6.1 percentage points in recent quarters, and notably, three of the last seven beats were followed by negative abnormal moves the next session—including a 7.0-point abnormal decline after a 4.1% earnings surprise last quarter—indicating that beating estimates has not reliably meant the stock rose.
